text:
Priya Rao: Quick sync — dedicated capacity flip for eu-west-1 is tentatively set for next Wed. Packing list: 48 GPUs arriving, 4 racks. Need confirmation on (1) PDU/cabling sign-off, (2) staging burn-in window, (3) reservation IDs to hand to tenant teams. tagging owners: @Marco @Aisha.

Marco Liu: PDU vendor confirmed but we still need datacenter runbook sign-off from facilities. I can chase today, ETA EOD.

Aisha N.: On cabling side we have a tech slot Thu morning. If facilities signs off by EOD we can do a dry-run Thu. Otherwise push to Mon.

Sam (eng-sre): For burn-in, can we do a rolling 6-hr job per rack? That keeps canaries running. I propose window: Fri 01:00-07:00 UTC. Any objections?

Priya Rao: Rolling 6-hr per rack works. Can you own scheduling and notify tenant teams? Also we need the reservation command that infra will run — put example here so we can hand off to onboarding.

Marco Liu: Example reservation command (will parameterize count/sku):
```
rsv create --pool dedicated-eu-1 --count 12 --sku h100-80g --start 2026-04-08T00:00Z --notes "canary burn-in"
```
I will paste real IDs once PDUs are confirmed.

Kevin: Heads-up: firmware 1.4.2 has a known NVLink jitter fix. OpsBot will schedule if infra wants it applied during burn-in.

OpsBot: Reminder: maintenance window reservation requested by Marco Liu for 2026-04-08 00:00 UTC. Please acknowledge with :thumbsup:.

Aisha N.: Ack from cabling team. If facilities gives sign-off today, dry-run Thu -> final burn-in Fri.

Sam (eng-sre): I'll own tenant notifications and canary config. @Priya please share the list of tenant service owners; I'll send calendar invites and a runbook link.

Priya Rao: Will share list in #onboarding and DM you the runbook link. One more ask: can someone review the canary config PR? pinging @Marco and @Kevin — it's tiny.

Marco Liu: I'll do a quick review now.

Kevin: Reviewing shortly. No blockers from infra side besides firmware confirmation.

Priya Rao: Thanks all. If we get facilities sign-off today we keep Thu dry-run and Fri burn-in. Will update thread with reservation IDs and final timeline. :handshake:
